summary.text: Ron Kresha is a Republican who represents District 10A in the Minnesota House of Representatives and was first elected in 2012.

His official House page lists committee assignments including Education Finance, Ways and Means, and Commerce Finance and Policy, and gives his occupation as chief operating officer, with a B.A. in English from St. Cloud State University and an M.B.A. from Bellevue University.

sources.title: Rep. Ron Kresha (10A) - Minnesota House of Representatives
